Procedure Name.cell: Nakanishi et al. (2022) CR Chondrite Metal HSE fs-LA-ICP-MS Spot v1
Procedure Name.value: Nakanishi et al. (2022) CR Chondrite Metal HSE fs-LA-ICP-MS Spot v1

Laboratory.cell: Dept. of Earth and Planetary Sciences, Tokyo Institute of Technology, Japan
Laboratory.value: Dept. of Earth and Planetary Sciences, Tokyo Institute of Technology, Japan

Funding Source for Procedure Development.cell: JSPS KAKENHI; Tokyo Institute of Technology
Funding Source for Procedure Development.value: JSPS KAKENHI; Tokyo Institute of Technology

Procedure Reference(s).cell: Nakanishi et al. (2022) GCA 319, 254; Walker et al. (2008) for IVB standards
Procedure Reference(s).value: Nakanishi et al. (2022) GCA 319, 254; Walker et al. (2008) for IVB standards

Coupling Description.cell: EPMA used to measure Ni concentration at the exact LA-ICP-MS analysis spot location, required for internal standardization of HSE data [Section 2.3]
Coupling Description.value: EPMA used to measure Ni concentration at the exact LA-ICP-MS analysis spot location, required for internal standardization of HSE data [Section 2.3]

Target Material.cell: CR chondrite metal grains (interior, margin, and isolated types)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: Grain > Spot — HSE abundances are reported per metal grain, each with its LA "spot No." (table p.6); the grains are typed by where they sit — interior grains in a chondrule, margin grains in its surficial shell, isolated grains in the matrix (p.1)

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Thick sections in petropoxy 154 resin, polished to 0.5 µm diamond paste, C-coated for EPMA then surface polished before LA
Sample Preparation Method.value: Thick sections in petropoxy 154 resin, polished to 0.5 µm diamond paste, C-coated for EPMA then surface polished before LA

Sampling Unit Selection Criteria.cell: Picked off prior electron images — "Based on the secondary electron images taken by EPMA, we selected analytical spots for LA-ICP-MS and sampling spots for micro-milling" (p.4); the grains themselves are sorted by setting into interior, margin and isolated metal (p.1)

Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.cell: Secondary-electron imaging on the EPMA, used to place every spot — "Based on the secondary electron images taken by EPMA, we selected analytical spots for LA-ICP-MS and sampling spots for micro-milling" (p.4); the spots carry numbers ("spot No." 201, 202 …) that tie the analyses back to those images (table p.6)
Pre-Analysis Imaging and Screening.value: Secondary-electron imaging on the EPMA, used to place every spot

Laser Manufacturer & Model.cell: Cyber Laser IFRIT (Ti:sapphire fs UV laser, 260 nm)
Laser Manufacturer & Model.value: Cyber Laser IFRIT (Ti:sapphire fs UV laser, 260 nm)

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: Ni micro-skimmer cone Xs; Ni sampler cone
Interface Cone Configuration.value: Ni micro-skimmer cone Xs; Ni sampler cone

Laser Wavelength and Type.cell: 260 nm Ti:sapphire femtosecond UV; pulse duration ~220 fs (IFRIT system)
Laser Wavelength and Type.value: 260 nm Ti:sapphire femtosecond UV; pulse duration ~220 fs (IFRIT system)

Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.cell: Carrier gas flow: 0.6 L/min; species not named (carrier gas identity not stated in Table 1 or text)
Carrier Gas and Flow Rate.value: Carrier gas flow: 0.6 L/min; species not named (carrier gas identity not stated in Table 1 or text)

Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.cell: Ar make-up: 0.9–1.2 l min⁻¹; Ar auxiliary: 0.6–1.2 l min⁻¹
Make-up Gas and Flow Rate.value: Ar make-up: 0.9–1.2 l min⁻¹; Ar auxiliary: 0.6–1.2 l min⁻¹

Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.cell: Cool gas: 12–13 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.6–1.2 l min⁻¹
Coolant (Plasma) Gas Flow Rate.value: Cool gas: 12–13 l min⁻¹ Ar; Auxiliary: 0.6–1.2 l min⁻¹

Analysis Sequence.cell: IVB meteorite standards (Warburton Range external + Tawallah Valley secondary) measured alongside unknowns; exact bracketing not described
Analysis Sequence.value: IVB meteorite standards (Warburton Range external + Tawallah Valley secondary) measured alongside unknowns; exact bracketing not described

Target Species.cell: ⁵⁹Co, ¹⁰¹Ru, ¹⁰³Rh, ¹⁰⁵Pd, ¹⁸⁵Re, ¹⁸⁹Os, ¹⁹³Ir, ¹⁹⁵Pt, ¹⁹⁷Au (9 HSE isotopes); ²⁴Mg, ²⁹Si, ³¹P, ³³S monitored for inclusion detection; ⁶¹Ni as internal standard

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Highly siderophile element abundances in metal (ppm: Ru, Rh, Pd, Re, Os, Ir, Pt, Au — e.g. "Ir abundance ranging from 1.08 to 2.53 ppm", p.5), with major element abundances from EPMA alongside; HSE/Ir ratios; and the Re/Os abundance ratio that feeds the reported 187Re/188Os, "determined by the mean Re/Os abundance ratios for each of the 1–3 analytical spots measured by LA-ICP-MS" (Table 3, p.8)

value.member: Highly siderophile element abundances in metal

Inter-Pass Data Dependency.cell: Single spot per location (30 µm circular)

Number of Replicates.cell: N (variable number of spots per grain; Mg, Si, P, S monitored to check for inclusions)

Internal Standard Approach.cell: Single element externally measured by EPMA: ⁶¹Ni concentration from EPMA at exact analysis location used as IS

members: Single element externally measured by EPMA
value.value: ⁶¹Ni concentration from EPMA at exact analysis location used as IS

Internal Standard Element.cell: ⁶¹Ni; concentration from EPMA measured at exact analysis spot location

Elemental Fractionation Correction.cell: External calibration using calibration curve method with IVB iron meteorite standards; ⁶¹Ni as IS from EPMA corrects for ablation yield differences between sample and standard

Matrix Offset Correction (LIEF).cell: N (fs laser minimizes LIEF; IVB iron meteorite standards used as matrix-matched reference)

Signal Integration Interval Method.cell: Time-resolved signals monitored; analyses with elevated Mg, Si, P, S (inclusion indicators) excluded; stable signal intervals used for integration
Signal Integration Interval Method.value: Time-resolved signals monitored; analyses with elevated Mg, Si, P, S (inclusion indicators) excluded; stable signal intervals used for integration

Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.cell: Monitoring of Mg, Si, P, S to check for micro-inclusions (sulfides); analyses with elevated inclusion signals excluded entirely
Spike / Outlier Filtering Approach.value: Monitoring of Mg, Si, P, S to check for micro-inclusions (sulfides); analyses with elevated inclusion signals excluded entirely

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: Gas blank measured before each spot; background period during single spot transient (rapid intensity rise and decay) used for background correction
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: Gas blank measured before each spot; background period during single spot transient (rapid intensity rise and decay) used for background correction

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: No explicit corrections applied; monitoring of Mg, Si, P, S used to detect and exclude inclusion-contaminated analyses rather than correct for spectral interferences
Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.value: No explicit corrections applied; monitoring of Mg, Si, P, S used to detect and exclude inclusion-contaminated analyses rather than correct for spectral interferences

Interfering Species.cell: Sulfide inclusions detectable via ³³S signal; phosphide inclusions via ³¹P; silicate inclusions via ²⁴Mg, ²⁹Si (used to exclude contaminated analyses)

Interference Correction Method.cell: Exclusion-based approach: analyses with elevated Mg, Si, P, S (from silicate, phosphate, or sulfide inclusions) excluded entirely rather than applying mathematical corrections

value.value: analyses with elevated Mg, Si, P, S (from silicate, phosphate, or sulfide inclusions) excluded entirely rather than applying mathematical corrections

Memory Effect Mitigation.cell: N (single spot analyses; no sequential memory effect described)

Normalization / Standards-Based Correcti.cell: No post-acquisition normalization; calibration curve method using IVB standards provides direct quantification

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially — the contributing counts are stated per grain, the reported ratios being "the mean Re/Os abundance ratios for each of the 1–3 analytical spots measured by LA-ICP-MS" (p.8). No acceptance or rejection rule is stated for the LA data; the 233/235 > 0.2 rejection (p.4) is a rule for the N-TIMS Os measurements, not for these spot analyses, and is not borrowed

Combination Method.cell: Re/Os abundance ratio: mean of the 1–3 spots on each metal grain; other: N — 'determined by the mean Re/Os abundance ratios for each of the 1–3 analytical spots measured by LA-ICP-MS' (Table 3)

value.value: mean of the 1–3 spots on each metal grain

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: Warburton Range (IVB iron meteorite; Walker et al. 2008) — used as primary external standard and for calibration curve method

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: Tawallah Valley (IVB iron meteorite; Walker et al. 2008) — measured as secondary/check standard alongside unknowns

Counting Statistics Error.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: Analytical uncertainties: 2SE of individual spot measurements reported alongside data

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: N (accuracy formally assessed by comparison with internal standard; absolute accuracy not separately reported)

Additional Notes.cell: fs laser (260 nm Ti:sapphire) essential for HSE measurement in metal (reduces elemental fractionation and matrix effects); IVB iron meteorite standards (Warburton Range + Tawallah Valley) as matrix-matched standards for iron meteorite metal
Additional Notes.value: fs laser (260 nm Ti:sapphire) essential for HSE measurement in metal (reduces elemental fractionation and matrix effects); IVB iron meteorite standards (Warburton Range + Tawallah Valley) as matrix-matched standards for iron meteorite metal
